basis: Accurately captures the statutory mandate in 42 U.S.C. 9908(a)(1) requiring the State chief executive officer to designate a lead agency in the application submitted under subsection (b).
Completely and faithfully reflects the duties of the lead agency specified under 42 U.S.C. 9908(a)(2).
Directly reflects the legislative hearing requirement and eligibility condition established in 42 U.S.C. 9908(a)(3).
Preserves the substantive elements and governing conditions of the State plan assurances under subsection (b), though heavily condensed in summary form.
Accurately defines 'cause' for a funding reduction pursuant to 42 U.S.C. 9908(c)(1).
Accurately defines 'cause' for a funding termination pursuant to 42 U.S.C. 9908(c)(2).
Fully preserves the discretionary authority granted to the Secretary in 42 U.S.C. 9908(d).
Reflects 42 U.S.C. 9908(e)(1) covering the discretionary revision of the plan and the mandatory submission of any revised plan to the Secretary.
Faithfully states the public inspection requirement under 42 U.S.C. 9908(e)(2).
Accurately captures the fiscal year 2000 transition rule provided in 42 U.S.C. 9908(f).
